submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, index 56 (Bi0.09 Cu0.44 V0.46) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.34e-6 A. That is the Cu:V ≈ 1 copper-vanadate region (β-Cu2V2O7-like, band gap ~2 eV), which absorbs strongly at 2.4 eV.

rejected.reason: The BiVO4-like Bi:V≈1 region with ~20% Cu gave 9.0e-7 A. BiVO4's gap is close to 2.4 eV, so it absorbs only weakly at this energy.
The Cu-richer Cu3V2O8-like composition gave 5.3e-7 A, suggesting that moving toward excess Cu lowers the photocurrent.
Not measured. CuBi2O4 usually behaves as a p-type photocathode, so it is unlikely to be a good photoanode.
